thought.text: The Vite dev server works — the frontend is served via the Rails proxy (`/assets/frontend/vite-dev/@vite/client` → 200). Let me confirm the actual desktop Vue entrypoint serves through the proxy:

reasoning_content:
The Vite dev server serves the `@vite/client` HMR client and the frontend entrypoint via the Rails proxy at `/assets/frontend/vite-dev/@vite/client` returning 200. Let me check the actual main entry to confirm the Vue frontend is served. Let me check what the desktop app entry is and test it via the proxy.

Actually, the key verification is complete. Let me just confirm the desktop Vue app entrypoint serves correctly through the proxy, then finalize.

action.command:
docker exec zammad-devcontainer-devcontainer-1 bash -lc '
code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" --max-time 60 "http://127.0.0.1:3000/assets/frontend/vite-dev/assets/frontend/apps/desktop/main.ts"); echo "desktop main.ts via proxy -> $code"
code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" --max-time 60 "http://127.0.0.1:3000/assets/frontend/vite-dev/assets/frontend/apps/desktop/index.html"); echo "desktop index.html via proxy -> $code"
echo "=== confirm dev processes still running ==="
ps aux | grep -E "forego start|puma|vite/bin|background-worker|websocket-server" | grep -v grep | awk "{print \$11, \$12, \$13}" | head
'
